verdict.rationale: BILL markets 'custom approval policies', budgets/tolerance rules, and 'automatically compliant' spend controls (docs-7, docs-9, docs-10, docs-20), which supports rule-based policy codification and in-policy auto-handling. However, the evidence is mostly marketing copy from the pricing page rather than detailed documentation on how limits are defined by category/role/context or how exceptions are specifically routed to a human approver. Missing for 10: granular documentation of category/role/context-based limit configuration, explicit auto-approve logic, and evidence of exception-routing workflow to humans.
